entity_types.business: The source's business/legal-person subject; legal form remains unknown unless stated.
entity_types.licence: An authorisation held by a business.
entity_types.establishment: A physical operating facility, separate from its operator.

ext.entity.former_name.definition: A legal name the business held before its current one. Use valid_from/valid_to paths when the source dates the name. Never a trading name.

ext.entity.legal_form.definition: Registrar's company type, decoded through a crosswalk table. Unknown codes -> unknown.

ext.entity.legal_form_detail.definition: Finer legal structure stated by the registrar (limited by shares/guarantee, listed, superannuation trustee, non-profit). Value is "CODE: label" from a crosswalk table.

ext.entity.status_detail.definition: The registrar's full status code and label ("EXAD: External administration"). The core entity.status enum stays coarse; distress codes live here.

ext.entity.date_established.definition: Founding / establishment date. Not a registration date.

ext.entity.sector_tag.definition: A source-stated activity or beneficiary tag, e.g. scheme acnc_purpose or acnc_beneficiary. Keep the publisher's wording.

ext.entity.industry_code.definition: ANZSIC 2006 division letter, subdivision, group or class, produced only through a reviewed crosswalk table from a source-stated activity (trade class, licence category, purpose). The raw source value is kept in raw_value. scheme = anzsic2006.

ext.entity.operating_region.definition: Where the business says it operates (service footprint), not where it is registered.

ext.entity.operating_country.definition: Country the business says it operates in, as the source writes it (one per observation).

ext.entity.tax_concession.definition: Tax-concession status stated by the regulator (Public Benevolent Institution, Health Promotion Charity).

ext.entity.responsible_persons.definition: Number of responsible persons (board size) the regulator reports.

ext.entity.financial_year_end.definition: Reporting-cycle end as dd-Mon (e.g. 30-Jun). Used to schedule refreshes.

ext.entity.prior_registration_state.definition: State of original incorporation before national registration. Not an address.

ext.entity.address_point.definition: lat,lon of the business's OWN stated address (e.g. a licensee's business address). A premises or site location is ext.establishment.geo on an establishment role instead.

ext.entity.holder_kind.definition: Whether the source says the record's holder is a natural person or an organisation. This is matching evidence. It never implies sole_trader.

ext.financial.total_income.definition: Total income as published for a stated reporting period. A fact for a period, not a current attribute.

ext.financial.taxable_income.definition: Taxable income for the period. Missing is not zero.

ext.financial.revenue_band.definition: A revenue/turnover band from a named scheme (acnc_size_2022, qbcc_mfr). The value must be a label of that scheme's crosswalk table; band thresholds live in the table, not in the claim.

ext.licence.number.definition: Publisher-assigned licence number. Identifies the licence across snapshots.

ext.licence.class.definition: Licence class / licensed trade in the publisher's wording.

ext.licence.category.definition: Licence category in the publisher's wording.

ext.licence.authorisation.definition: One authorised activity per observation (split the publisher's list).

ext.licence.authorisation_text.definition: Complete publisher authorisation text, including headings and conditions. Unparsed source evidence, not independent permission claims.

ext.licence.start_date.definition: Publisher-stated commencement of the licence, not the business establishment or registration date.

ext.licence.end_date.definition: Publisher-stated end of the licence, not the end of the business or all its claims.

ext.licence.status.definition: Licence status as published (licence status, not company status).

ext.licence.condition.definition: Licence condition such as trading hours.

ext.licence.status_event.definition: A dated status-history entry (e.g. a contravention of a licence condition).

ext.licence.related_licence_number.definition: Number of another licence the same holder holds (e.g. an AFS licence number). 0 / blank = none.

ext.establishment.source_key.definition: Publisher's site code. Identifies the site across snapshots.

ext.establishment.geo.definition: "lat,lon" in decimal degrees inside Australia. The literal NULL is missing.

ext.establishment.region.definition: Publisher's region (licensing region, metro/regional, employment services area).

ext.establishment.capacity.definition: Published maximum patron count or similar capacity.

ext.establishment.program.definition: Government programme or contract code delivered at this site.

ext.contact.phone.definition: Phone number normalised to E.164 (+61...). Numbers shorter than 8 digits or without an area code are rejected. Mobiles are personal data unless published as a business line.

ext.contact.email_domain.definition: The domain of a published email address. Personal local parts are never stored.

ext.contact.role_email.definition: A role mailbox (info@, enquiries@, admin@ ...). Personal mailboxes are dropped by the transform.

ext.contact.website_domain.definition: Registrable host of a published website (www. removed).

entity.legal_name.definition: As registered. Not the trading name.

entity.trading_name.definition: May be multiple. Emit one observation each.

entity.abn.definition: Australian Business Number. Has a checksum — validate it, do not just length-check.

entity.acn.definition: Australian Company Number. Also checksummed. The last 9 digits of an ABN are often the ACN, but not always.

entity.nzbn.definition: New Zealand Business Number, if you happen to hit an NZ source.

entity.entity_type.definition: Default to unknown. Guessing here causes downstream harm.

entity.industry_code.definition: ANZSIC where available. Record the raw source value too.

observation.source_id.definition: Stable identifier for the dataset the claim came from.

observation.source_record_id.definition: Must be traceable back to the exact raw record. If the source has no key, construct a deterministic one and document how.

observation.ingested_at.definition: When you read it. These are different and both matter.

observation.valid_from.definition: When the claim became true in the world, if the source says.

observation.valid_to.definition: Null means still current as far as this source knows.

observation.licence.definition: From the dataset metadata. CKAN exposes it. If a source has no clear licence, that is a finding, not a blocker — record 'unknown' and flag it.

observation.extractor_version.definition: Which version of your mapping config and engine produced this. You will be glad of it later.

confidence.source_reliability.definition: How much do we trust this publisher on this kind of claim.

confidence.field_confidence.definition: How sure are we that we mapped and parsed this field correctly.

confidence.link_confidence.definition: How sure are we that this record refers to that entity. Only on links.

dyn.workforce.employer_name.definition: The employer/reporting-unit name as stated by the publisher for this row. This is a publisher-reported employer name, not a registrar-stated legal name; it is not unique and may coincide with a corporate group name.
dyn.workforce.employer_name.why_not_existing: entity.legal_name asserts a registrar-stated legal name, which this WGEA employer spreadsheet does not state; the inspector warns employer names are not unique and can also be corporate group names. A distinct publisher-reported employer-name concept avoids conflating a reporting-unit name with a legal name.

dyn.workforce.employer_size_band.definition: The employer size band stated by the publisher for the reporting employer, kept as the publisher's band label rather than an exact headcount. Values are the WGEA bands as written in the source.
dyn.workforce.employer_size_band.why_not_existing: No existing concept carries an employer headcount band. ext.financial.revenue_band is a revenue/turnover band, not a workforce band, and reusing it would change meaning. The band is not an exact employee count, so it must not be stored as an integer headcount.

dyn.workforce.sector_classification.definition: The publisher's sector classification for the reporting employer (e.g. Private, Public). This is a WGEA sector classification, not a legal form and not an ANZSIC industry.
dyn.workforce.sector_classification.why_not_existing: ext.entity.sector_tag is a source-stated activity or beneficiary tag (e.g. acnc_purpose), not a public/private sector classification. ext.entity.legal_form is a registrar legal form and must not be inferred from this value. A new concept with an explicit scheme qualifier keeps the publisher's classification distinct.

dyn.workforce.anzsic_division.definition: The ANZSIC Division name stated by the publisher for the employer (e.g. Transport, Postal and Warehousing). Kept as the publisher's division label. Same ANZSIC 2006 scheme as dyn.workforce.anzsic_class, at the coarser division level; neither is crosswalked to a code.
dyn.workforce.anzsic_division.why_not_existing: ext.entity.industry_code is restricted to ANZSIC division letters/subdivision/group/class codes produced through a reviewed crosswalk, and entity.industry_code is a single unqualified code. The source states a division name, not a code, so a name-valued concept with scheme=anzsic2006 is needed rather than forcing a code.

dyn.workforce.anzsic_class.definition: The ANZSIC Class name stated by the publisher for the employer (e.g. Computer System Design and Related Services). Kept as the publisher's class label. Same ANZSIC 2006 scheme as dyn.workforce.anzsic_division, at the finer class level; neither is crosswalked to a code.
dyn.workforce.anzsic_class.why_not_existing: ext.entity.industry_code holds codes only and entity.industry_code is a single unqualified code. The source states a class name, so a separate name-valued concept with scheme=anzsic2006 avoids inventing a code and avoids overloading the code concept.

dyn.workforce.total_workforce_women_shar.definition: Share of the employer's total workforce who are women, as a proportion (0-1) stated by the publisher for the reporting period.
dyn.workforce.total_workforce_women_shar.why_not_existing: No existing concept captures a workforce gender composition share. It is not a pay gap, not a remuneration amount, and not a headcount, so no existing financial or entity concept fits.

dyn.workforce.quartile_women_share.definition: Share of women (0-1) in a named pay quartile of the employer's workforce, as stated by the publisher for the reporting period. The quartile is identified by the quartile qualifier.
dyn.workforce.quartile_women_share.why_not_existing: No existing concept represents gender composition within a pay quartile. It is distinct from the total workforce share and from remuneration amounts, so a new concept with an explicit quartile qualifier is required.

dyn.workforce.quartile_average_total_rem.definition: Average total remuneration in dollars for a named pay quartile of the employer's workforce, as stated by the publisher for the reporting period. This is remuneration, not revenue or business income. Currency is inferred as AUD from the Australian federal publisher; the source header states only '($)'.
dyn.workforce.quartile_average_total_rem.why_not_existing: ext.financial.total_income, taxable_income and tax_payable are business income/tax measures, not employee remuneration. No existing concept holds per-quartile average remuneration, so a new money concept with currency, currency_basis and period qualifiers is needed.

dyn.workforce.total_workforce_average_to.definition: Average total remuneration in dollars across the employer's total workforce, as stated by the publisher for the reporting period. Remuneration, not revenue or business income. Currency is inferred as AUD from the Australian federal publisher; the source header states only '($)'.
dyn.workforce.total_workforce_average_to.why_not_existing: Existing financial concepts are business income/tax measures. This is an employee remuneration average for the whole workforce, distinct from the per-quartile concept, so it needs its own concept.

dyn.workforce.gender_pay_gap.definition: Gender pay gap as a proportion (0-1, may be negative) stated by the publisher for the reporting period, identified by the remuneration basis (base salary or total remuneration) and the statistic (average or median) qualifiers. A derived gap measure, not a pay level. The publisher already expresses the gap as a proportion despite the '(%)' header (observed values like 0.044, 0.221); a future percent-formatted value would need a percent-to-proportion step.
dyn.workforce.gender_pay_gap.why_not_existing: No existing concept represents a gender pay gap. It is a derived percentage measure, not a remuneration amount, not business income, and not a workforce share, so none of the existing financial or workforce concepts fit.
